items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: The first time I joined Kenton was in 1948... then I went back in ‘50 or ‘51... That was my favorite Kenton band.

ctx.x: We haven’t even talked so far about what recordings you had made up until that point.

That’s right. You know I actually when I was with Charlie Ventura we worked a club in New York called The Royal Roost. And Bird was working opposite. This was 1949. So he heard me play. And I knew him at that time. I didn’t know really what he thought of my playing, and it doesn’t make any difference, because he was a gentleman and a beautiful cat. And I was so inspired by his playing, that I don’t care what he thought about me. He liked me and that was good enough. And then of course later I recorded with Kenton…
